{{Quote|I am Seetoo Enntoo, steward of this vessel. It is my extreme good fortune to serve you.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Introducing C2N2|the ''Defender''-class corvette}}</ref>}}
'''C2-N2''', also known as '''Seetoo Enntoo''', was a [[Hollis-series steward droid]] produced by [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]] and owned by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]]. Assigned to the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|Hero's ''Defender''-class light corvette]] as its steward in [[3643 BBY]], C2-N2 was responsible for maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and ensuring that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] crew remained comfortable. It served aboard the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class corvette]] for the next several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], caring for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the ship's crew as they participated in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome home, master. I hope you find your vessel a model of efficiency, convenience and comfort.|C2-N2|<ref name="Ambient" />}}
C2-N2, also known Seetoo Enntoo, was a [[Hollis-series steward droid]],<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> a [[Class three droid/Legends|third-degree]] [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]] produced by [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> C2-N2 was assigned to a [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] that was requisitioned by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. C2-N2 and the ship were delivered to [[Docking Bay 74]] of the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they greeted the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hero of Tython|new owner]]&mdash;a young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had been tasked with foiling the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|attempts]] to destroy the Republic with stolen [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] explained its role as steward of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|new ship]] and gave the Knight a tour of the vessel.<ref name="TOR:IC" /> Over the next two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Seetoo continued to serve as the ship's steward as the Knight, who became known as the Hero of Tython, served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=other|Jedi Knight's Act I, II & III}}</ref>

[[File:HeroOfTythonDefenderClassLightCorvette-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|250px|The Hero of Tython's ''Defender''-class corvette]]
The droid frequently made adjustments to the ship's systems and accommodations, such as adding extra padding to the vessel's seat cushions, reprogramming the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] [[Food synthesizer/Legends|food synthesizer]], programming the air circulators to simulate the smell of [[Alderaanian nectar]] or other pleasing aromas, and dusting the crew's quarters.<ref name="Ambient">{{TORcite|Ambient Conversation aboard the ''Defender''-class corvette}}</ref> It was frequently the subject of jokes between the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] and the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]].<ref name="Kira">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20121023|text=Companions 101: Kira Carsen}}</ref> The droid also ensured that the other members of the Hero's crew&mdash;[[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]&mdash;were comfortable aboard the starship.<ref name="Ambient" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|C2-series droids represent the latest advances in everything from starship technical maintenance to nutritional advice tailored for your specific organic needs.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC" />}}
A golden-plated droid with yellow [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], C2-N2 was programmed with knowledge in a wide range of subjects, including [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]], nutrition, and [[Technician/Legends|technical maintenance]]. Seetoo was also capable of modifying other technology, performing long-range surveillance, [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]], custodial duties, and a number of other tasks. Seetoo prided himself on attention to detail, and its primary programming was to provide for its master's creature comforts and to maintain the vessel it was assigned to.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hero of Tython's C2-N2 is the steward character on the ''Defender''-class light corvette belonging to the Jedi Knight class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. Beyond the initial conversation with the player after they receive their ship,<ref name="TOR:IC" /> the Knight has no interaction with the droid other than ambient conversation,<ref name="Ambient" /> though they can send C2-N2 on crew skill missions to gather resources or to construct items.<ref name="TOR" />
